hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only the afterInitialize permission as a no-op callback. Liquidity bootstrapping is performed via a separate initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to record the initial tick. No swap, liquidity, or donate hook logic is present.
